Commentary.Commentary: South Africa should chase this down, there is a little bit of grip in the wicket but Pakistan are at least 20 short. Can the visitors weave some magic with the ball? We will find out. Shaheen Afridi is the man who will start off the bowling.
Here we go! The chase begins! The Pakistani fielders have taken the field and the openers follow. Janneman Malan and Aiden Markram will open.

The spinners were brilliant for South Africa! They were the ones who actually caused problems, both Shamsi and Linde were in top form. Hendricks also had a decent outing and Williams impressed again. However, Magala did not have the best of nights yet again but he came back strongly in the end.

The visitors lost Rizwan early, actually on the first ball itself, then Sharjeel followed. Hafeez and Azam did steady the ship but Pakistan kept losing wickets at regular intervals and that was their problem! Azam did score a half ton but he did not look at his best. His innings just never got going and the others did not hang in there. In the end, they have fallen short of a total which they would have thought of.

Tremendous stuff from South Africa! Without any doubt they will be much happier with where they stand in the game at the moment! For Pakistan, winning the toss is the only right thing that has happened for them.
Just a single to end the innings! Full ball on the pads. Afridi clips it to deep mid-wicket. Excellent comeback by Magala after going for runs in his first over. PAKISTAN FINISH AT 140 FOR 9!
Dot ball, Gold dust! Yorker on the pads, Afridi backs away a bit and attempts the flick but fails to get any bat on it.

OUT! RUN OUT! Pakistan's innings has gone off the rails in the last few overs and this is no different! Full ball, outside off. Qadir fails to get any bat on it. Shaheen Afridi is eager to get on strike and runs. Qadir decides to sacrifice his wicket and is run out after Heinrich Klaasen throws the ball to the bowler.
Afridi tries the same thing but gets some bat on it! Similar ball and Afridi goes for the lap shot, ends up getting the edge towards the off side for one.
Innovative but to no avail! Length ball, outside off. Qadir shuffles across and looks to lap it over the keeper but misses it altogether. A leg bye is taken.
Full ball, on the pads. Clipped away to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Good shot to end the over! Full one outside off. Afridi smokes it wide of long off and picks up a valuable boundary.
Good effort at covers. Length ball, outside off. Qadir strikes it well but the fielder dives and keeps it to one.
Just a single! Full one again, outside off. This is hit to long off.
Full ball, outside off. Afridi looks to drive it but fails to connect.
Yorker, on the stumps. Jabbed way to mid-wicket for one. South Africa won't mind that.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Williams strikes again! Slower one outside off, it is short and Nawaz goes for the cut. Ends up getting the edge back to the keeper, Heinrich Klaasen dives forward and takes a good catch.
No run.
Shaheen Afridi comes out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! There is the wicket Pakistan did not want to lose! Magala is absolutely delighted and rightly so! South Africa can surely keep them under 150 now! This is fuller and around off, Azam looks to heave it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the stumps.
Just a single again! On middle, this is hit back towards the stumps at the other end. It hits it and deflects towards the leg side for one.
Fifty for Azam! Not the most fluent of innings but he needs to stay there till the end, ensures his side finishes strongly, gets there by working it through square leg for one.
Just another single now! That though gets Azam on strike! This is fuller and outside off, it is guided to point for one.
Just a single! On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Mohammad Nawaz is the new man in. Sisanda Magala to bowl his third over.

OUT! HE HOLES OUT! A wave from Williams too! Hasan does not appreciate it but the bowler gets his revenge! A slower one, it is fuller and on off. Ali hits it flat but finds the fielder at long off. End of an action-packed over.
SIX! Over long off this time! Hasan Ali is on fire here, like has been throughout the seires! This is fuller and on off, Ali lofts it yet again and gets it over the fence. Can he go three in a row?
SIX! Muscled over the fence! The reason why he has been promoted! Needs no sighter and he has smashed it! Slower length ball around middle, this is hit just over the long on fence for a biggie.
An appeal but turned down! Angled into the pads. Azam looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
With half the side back in the hut, who is going to come out now? Hasan Ali is in now, he will look to play some big shots.

OUT! TAKEN! Faheem is out of here now and Azam continues to see wickets falling at the other end. This is shorter and on middle, Ashraf slams it flat but straight down the throat of the fielder at long on who takes an easy catch. 150 now looks difficult.
Fuller and on off, it is pushed down to long off for one.
Who will bowl from the other end? Lizaad Williams will have a go now.
A single to end! So not a bad spell from Hendricks, did not take a wicket but was economic! Length and outside off, this is guided to short third man for one.
FOUR! That is a welcome, welcome boundary! This is a slower short ball and it is very cleverly played. Azam waits for it and then plays an upper cut, towards the third man boundary.
Singles won't harm South Africa! This is fuller and outside off, it is carved through covers for one.
Swing and a miss! Length and outside off, Faheem looks to go downtown but misses.
Just another single! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one more.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Beuran Hendricks is back into the attack.
Short and outside off. Azam cuts it to point. Just three from the over and end of a wonderful spell from Tabraiz Shamsi.
Short ball, on off. Ashraf pulls it down to long on for one.
A muted appeal but turned down. Googly by Shamsi, Faheem doesn't pick it and is hit on the pads while looking to defend. The ball was probably sliding down leg.
Flatter ball, around off. Defended off the back foot.
A touch shorter, on off. Azam pulls it well but straight to deep mid-wicket. Just a single.
Short and wide outside off. Cut way to deep point for one.
Full ball, outside off. Azam carves it to backward point.
Length ball, outside off. Whipped away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length, outside off. Ashraf pushes it to point.
Length ball, outside off. Driven to long off for one.
Full ball, outside off. Azam leaves it thinking it was a wide but the umpire deems it to be a legal delivery.
FOUR! Magala is struggling here! Length ball on the pads. Azam flicks it to deep square leg fence.
A single to end! Azam works this through mid-wicket for one.
Who will come out now? Faheem Ashraf is the new man.

OUT! TAKEN! Shamsi with a wicket yet again! This is tossed up outside off, Haider Ali comes down the track and looks to go big but does not get to the pitch of it. He ends up slicing it towards long off where the fielder runs to left and takes a sliding catch. So once again, just as Pakistan were looknig to get a move on, South Africa strike. Shamsi has been brilliant so far.
Shorter and on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
A low full toss, this is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
The googly now, it lands on middle, defended.

NOT OUT! The impact is umpire's call! Not a bad review to be honest! Could have gone either way. It is tossed up outside off, turns back in. Ali picks it and looks to work it on the leg side by getting his front pad out of the line. He misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but turned down. Shamsi convinces his skipper to get it reviewed. Klaasen does so but it shows that the impact is umpire's call.
A huge appeal but turned down! South Africa review! Seems to be doing too much!
Length ball, outside off. Azam dabs it to point. Massive over for Pakistan, 18 from it.
Another full one, but this is down the leg side. Wide given.
FOUR! Magala's misery continues! This is a good ball but Azam is a better player. Full ball, just outside off. Azam runs it past short third man for a boundary.
Full ball, on the stumps. Azam looks to flick it but gets the inside edge on the pads.
Full ball, on the off stump. Pushed past Magala for a single.
Full ball, but wrong line. This is way down the leg side. This turning out be one long over.
Full ball, on the stumps. Flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Finally a legal ball and it goes for a four! Full ball, outside off. Ali carves it past point and to the ropes. So that's effectively 9 runs in one ball for South Africa.
Pressure is getting to Magala here! Full ball and wide outside off. Wide given. Free hit again.
Oh no! He has overstepped again! Short ball, and this one goes over Ali's head. Free hit continues.
No ball! Full ball and Azam drills it straight to sweeper cover. Magala has overstepped and the free hit continues.
Length ball, on the pads. Azam clips it to short fine leg. No ball given as Magala had overstepped. Free hit coming up.
Magala is on now!
FOUR! Cracking shot to get off the mark! Short and wide outside off. Haider Ali cuts it to the backward point fence.
Haider Ali walks out to bat! Good chance for the youngster to show what he can do.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Linde is having a great match here and Pakistan slide further! Shorter ball, lands on off and turns away a bit. Hafeez thinks there is room on this one and looks to run it down to third man. Ends up getting a fine edge to the keeper. Heinrich Klaasen takes it nicely.
Tossed up, on middle and leg. Azam sweeps but gets the top edge past short third man for one.
Quicker one on off. Punched down to long on for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Pushed past covers for one.
Short and wide outside off. Azam is beaten on the cut.
A good slower one, it is fuller and outside off. Hafeez looks to drive but misses. So despite the boundary, it is a good over from the bowler.
Almost an action replay of the first ball! Hafeez was the batter this time. Extra bounce again! Shorter and outside off. Mohammad looks to guide it again but misses.

FOUR! Deft! Hafeez into the 30s. Hafeez just shows what Azam needed to do one the first ball. This is shorter and outside off. Hafeez waits for it and then guides it down to the third man fence beautifully.
Just the one! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Really full and on middle, this is jammed out towards covers.
Extra bounce! Azam though is disappointed with himself! This is shorter and outside off, Azam looks to cut but is done in by the extra bounce.
Flighted ball, outside off. Pushed past covers for one.

NOT OUT! Azam was just inside the crease! Googly by Shamsi and Azam doesn't pick it. The whizzes past the outside edge and Heinrich Klaasen whips the bails off. He looks very confident. Third umpire is called. Replay shows that even though Azam dragged his foot outside the crease, he brought it back in time.
A stumping appeal and it has been referred! Klaasen is very confident.
Full ball, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Short ball, on the stumps. Azam backs away and then cuts it past the diving point fielder for a couple.
Tossed up, outside off. Hafeez pushes it to long off for one.
Full ball, outside off. Drilled to sweeper cover for one.
Another single to end! 9 from Lizaad's first! On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
That is a superb effort in the field! Fuller and outside off, Hafeez smacks it towards cover. Malan there dives to his left and saves three for his side.
FOUR! That is a superb pick up shot! Angled into the pads, Hafeez loves it there. He flicks it behind square on the leg side for another boundary.
Azam now takes one as he clips it through mid-wicket.
An appeal but turned down! Angled into the pads, Hafeez looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
Change from both the ends! Lizaad Williams is into the attack now.
Drop and run! On off, Azam pushes it towards cover for one.
FOUR! Once again two boundaries in the over! This one is swept on line. On the pads, Hafeez sweeps it over short fine leg and it races away. Back-to-back good overs for Pakistan.

Catch it is the call but not sure if it was off the bat. This is shorter and on leg, spins back in. Hafeez looks to pull but it hits the pad and lobs towards the keeper. He does not spot it and does not take it.
Plays it with the turn through mid-wicket for one.
Quicker and outside off, Hafeez looks to guide it but there is not enough room to play that shot. It goes off the glove towards short third man. One taken.
Shorter and on middle, Azam goes back to pull but does not time it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack, Shamsi! Runs comnig now. On the pads, this is swept nicely, behind square on the leg side and a boundary results. Good start to the over.
Bowling change! Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack.

FOUR! Uppish but safe! Finally a good over for Pakistan and it was the last one of the Powerplay but South Africa ahead after the first 6. Pakistan are 35 for 2. The last ball is shorter and around off, Hafeez guides it, it is in the air but wide of point and into the fence.
One more dot! Slower one, it is on off, Hafeez guides it to point.
Angled into the pads, Azam works it through square leg for one. Good sensible batting.
FOUR! EDGY FOUR! This one stayed a touch low! Shorter and outside off. Azam slashes at it. It goes off the outside edge and to the third man fence. Welcome boundary, streaky but Pakistan won't mind!

A muted appeal but turned down! It is a little too straight, Hafeez looks to work it on the leg side but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the off side. One taken. Maybe there was an inside edge as there is no signal from the umpire.
Length and that is hit on the up, through covers but just for one.
Short and wide outside off. Cut away to covers.
Full ball, on the pads. Hafeez comes down the track but gets the inside edge on his pads.
Flighted ball, on off. Azam uppishly sweeps it but the ball bounces it front of deep mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, but goes down the leg side. Umpire gives it a wide.
Quicker ball, on the stumps. Clipped away past mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Through the fielder! Short and outside off. Hafeez cuts it well. Andile Phehlukwayo at point dives to stop it but the ball runs under his fingers to the ropes.
Flatter ball, on the stumps. Defended.
Good length ball, around middle and leg. Clipped to the leg side for one.
FOUR! Good shot to get going! Length ball, lands on middle and angles across Hafeez. He waits for it and then runs it past short third man and to the ropes.
Length ball, no width whatsoever. Hafeez plays it to point.
Length ball, around off. Azam looks to drive it on the up but mistimes it past mid off. Quick single is taken.
Fuller this time, Azam looks to drive it but ends it mistiming it to mid off.
Back of a length ball, around off. Azam defends this one.
Full ball, around off. Pushed past covers for one.
Mohammead Hafeez walks out to bat!

OUT! TAKEN! Second wicket down and South Africa are off to a flier! Linde tosses this outside off. Sharjeel Khan looks to play the same shot that fetched him his first six. Ends up hitting it to Aiden Markram at mid off. The pair of Linde and Markram does it again.
Short and outside off. Khan goes for the cut but doesn't have the width on that one. Beaten.
A fuller one this time, on the pads. Flicked away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and touch wide outside off. Azam cuts it to covers.
Flatter ball, on the stumps. Clipped away to mid-wicket.
Swing and a miss! Length ball, outside off. Khan goes for the big slog but fails to connect.
This one lands on a length, outside off and nips back in. Sharjeel looks to work it to the on side but is rapped on the pads.
Extra bounce there! Short and wide outside off. Khan goes for the cut but the ball goes past the edge.
Length ball, around his pads. Azam clips it past mid-wicket and gets off the mark.
A touch shorter this time, Khan drags it to the deep mid-wicket fielder and gets off the strike.
Starts with a length ball, around off. Pushed to covers.
Hendricks to bowl from the other end!
Flatter ball, clipped away to mid-wicket for one. Despite the six, South Africa would be happy with the over.
SIX! Sharjeel Khan and Pakistan are underway! This is absolutely crunched! Tossed up, outside off. Sharjeel Khan smokes it over the long off fence.
Flatter ball, outside off. It is pushed to point.
Tossed up, right on the fourth stump. Khan defends it.
Loopy ball, around off. Pushed to covers.
Babar Azam walks out to bat now!

OUT! TAKEN! Dream start for South Africa! Linde tossed this outside off. Rizwan wants to hit this out of here and comes down the track. Ends up skying it high in the air in the mid off region. Aiden Markram settles under it and takes it. Not sure why he would do such a thing against someone who turns the ball away from him. A rush of blood moment for Rizwan or probably it was pre determined. A big wicket though for South Africa as he was in superb form.

We are all set for the action to begin! The Pakistan openers, a new opening combination today, Sharjeel Khan and Mohammad Rizwan walk out to bat! The right-hander will take strike and he will be facing some spin first up as it is George Linde who has the ball in hand. Here we go...

SOUTH AFRICA PLAYING XI (Unchanged) - Janneman Malan, Aiden Markram, Wihan Lubbe, Heinrich Klaasen(w/c), Pite van Biljon, George Linde, Andile Phehlukwayo, Sisanda Magala, Beuran Hendricks, Lizaad Williams, Tabraiz Shamsi

PAKISTAN PLAYING XI (Two changes) - Mohammad Rizwan(w), Sharjeel Khan, Babar Azam(c), Mohammad Hafeez, Haider Ali, Mohammad Nawaz, Faheem Ashraf, Hasan Ali, Shaheen Afridi, Usman Qadir, Mohammad Hasnain
TOSS - PAKISTAN HAVE WON THE TOSS AND OPTED TO BAT!
Some news coming in is that Fakhar Zaman has been ruled out of this game due to an injury! This is a big miss as he has been the man in form for Pakistan.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the second T20I between South Africa and Pakistan. This one is a must-win for the hosts as a loss will take away the chance of them winning the series. Pakistan on the other hand, will ensure they can't lose it if they emerge victorious here. The first one was a cracker, the venue is the same so we could well be in for another superb game. Stay tuned for the toss in a bit.
